messages:
michelle: FYI @devon @sarah - Crucible reported 5m p95 spikes and intermittent 502s since 02:00 UTC. They've escalated to P1 and want engineering to own a short-term mitigation.
ops-bot: [ALERT] crucible-prod: 502 errors > 5% for 10m. incident-id: INC-2026-789
devon: I'm in. Can someone paste a sample request id and timeframe? I have a quick idea: route to a lower-latency model variant as a fallback.
michelle: sample req: req_20260315_2312 (from support ticket). Spike started 02:03 UTC. Customer is on Dedicated; SLA target 99.9% p99, currently rolling 99.5%.
raj: oncall here. I'll open a short-lived routing override to send Crucible tenant to pool-dedicated-b during 02:30-04:30 UTC. Command:
```sh
redwoodctl routing override --tenant crucible --route pool-dedicated-b --until 2026-03-16T04:30:00Z
```
I'll coordinate with infra.
sarah: I can own the rollout and monitoring. Plan:
1) apply routing override (raj)
2) bump KV-cache TTL for crucible
3) watch traces & p99 for 30m
4) rollback if errors persist
I need @finops sign-off for TTL change (cost implications).
devon: Quick serving tweak: disable KV prefetch for tenant to reduce noisy coldstarts. Patch in PR 4621. I can cut a canary now, needs code review @sarah @michelle.
michelle: michelle approves the canary. Timeline: raj runs override in 5m, devon merges canary +15m, sarah watches. Customer call at 03:00 UTC — we need an updated status then.
sarah: Starting monitoring dash now, will post p50/p95/p99 every 10m.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: PR 4621 merged to canary by devon at 02:20 UTC — healthchecks passing.
devon: Canary looks clean on canary-1 (p99 down from ~900ms -> ~220ms). Planning gradual promote 50% -> 100% over 20m after green checks.
michelle: Crucible PM confirms degraded but accepts workaround. They'll postpone large batch jobs until 06:00 UTC. Thanks team.
sarah: Promoting to 50% now. Current p99 240ms. Will update when at 100%.
raj: routing override applied. ACLs updated. If it looks bad I'll revert at 04:30 UTC.
michelle: noted. Who's owning the postmortem and customer timeline? Suggest devon + sarah co-own. Agree?
devon: happy to co-own. I'll draft timeline + attach perf traces.
michelle: closing update: mitigation in place, oncall monitoring, customer notified. INC-2026-789 -> linked to PR/CR-4621. Postmortem due 2026-03-17 EOD.
sarah: added runbook checklist and will attach traces to the incident.
devon: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
